observations.classification: Prior same-agent conditional 95e observation linked to historical q1177; no duplicate count
source_trace: 2490 P16/95e 120–127: if configured target speeds reject, the system logs and returns before the rig loop.

Current target_speed.rs:15–28 converts four signed step lengths multiplied by configured frequency into NonnegativeSpeed, propagating each error. Current combat_config.rs:121–148 and 672–697 retain those four steps as SignedLength but the displayed IK validation does not check their signs or products; runtime.rs:11–20,59–80 validates on install and reads the dedicated cached IK block.

Prior own /root/hair_ops packet separately read SignedLength, AnimationFrequency and NonnegativeSpeed constructors, preserved here under prior/ik/support with their exact earlier receipt; those show finite signed lengths can be negative, positive finite frequency is admitted, and negative or nonfinite resulting speed is rejected.
observations.condition: If an otherwise valid supported configuration reaches a negative nonzero step or a finite positive product overflows, configured() can fail and the visible system returns for all rigs. Current shipped tuning, actual configuration ingress, all validation paths, runtime scheduling and player/visual effects were not exercised or fully established.

observations.future_direction: Clarify allowed semantic step and representable speed policy at the existing admission owner; preserve legitimate zero and shipped positive values if later authorized to repair.

nonfindings: At IK lines286–310 the blend target is re-admitted as UnitInterval after the configured rate and elapsed budget; zero rate or a booleanized desired target alone does not prove a failure.

The native LodMesh attribute/index representation is a real mesh boundary; this bounded source evidence does not justify wrapping every vertex scalar or assuming a malformed batch is accepted by a supported path.
Materials display shows a named stream and eight appearance variants with a shared list; this does not prove current sampled distribution or a renderer outcome.

95e query excludes PoseCulled rigs while P16 does not (2490 line111); how do culling transitions, independent post-propagation observation and scheduler timing interact? Prior own packet records a conditional lifecycle question, not a proven cull defect.
Can supported LodMesh producers or decoders exceed u32 index capacity or violate correlated vertex/index/tangent constraints?
Which exact building/furniture identity namespaces should feed the shared visual seed owner, and are their numerical representations intentionally comparable?
All large IK/body, P16/currents outside actual receipt windows, native renderer/Bevy, other constructors and all thirteen repository-wide populations remain unassessed here.

lens_perspectives.producer_propagation: IK typed step×frequency reaches NonnegativeSpeed; visual building and furniture words reach a named stream; LodMesh reaches native mesh arrays, each only for the registered current windows.
lens_perspectives.existing_type_owners: SignedLength, NonnegativeSpeed, AnimationFrequency, ResponseRate, UnitInterval and stream identities already exist; compare semantic fit rather than add wrappers indiscriminately.
lens_perspectives.admission_contracts: Signed versus nonnegative speed and LodMesh independently deserialized arrays need exact supported-input admission proof; qualified rig source role excludes triangle for wear=None.
lens_perspectives.invariant_operations: Step×frequency, rate×elapsed and u32 base offsets cross operation boundaries; invalid-sign/overflow hypotheses require supported inputs.
lens_perspectives.aggregate_states: Lod vertices and indices must agree at tangent/native consumption; blend state must stay in UnitInterval; material source identity/seed/appearance relations remain distinct.
lens_perspectives.type_ownership: Config should own tuning sign/product policy; LodMesh generation/admission owns aggregate capacity; shared seed conversion needs a semantic cross-caller owner.
lens_perspectives.redundant_authority: New IK accessor selects the same animation.inverse_kinematics member through its own version-keyed cache; synchronization/reload concurrency not settled. No independent palette authority failure proven.
lens_perspectives.behavior_preservation: 2490 changes query cull filter and accessor at 95e; 2503 bytes match; 2512 current differences are mechanically outside these fresh production windows and prior same-agent packet read relevant test changes. Preserve specific source semantics without runtime equivalence claims.
lens_perspectives.enum_shapes: Appearance variants remain explicit enum branches; no enum shape repair demonstrated in these bounded scopes.
lens_perspectives.derivability: LodMesh derives Serialize/Deserialize and stores public parallel vectors; derive presence alone neither proves semantic invariants nor warrants boilerplate removal.
lens_perspectives.type_granularity: Physical length, elapsed time, speed, normalized blend, material identity, seed and GPU vertex/index are distinct roles requiring different owners.
lens_perspectives.magic_strings: visual.building.appearance is a named deterministic stream identity, not necessarily user text. Existing warning/expect messages do not alone establish a string classification defect.
lens_perspectives.magic_numbers: 100-bucket appearance thresholds and indexed vertex offsets are separate authored selection and representation constraints; preserve semantics and prove limits before choosing owners.
